main_text.l: XLIX. Ejusdem EPISTOLA AD JULIUM Ducem Brunsvicensem.

Cum apud Illustrissimos & Electores, aliosque multos Germaniae Principes cum apud Illustrissimum & Serenissimum Regem Daniae Legatione mea perfunctus fuerim, & ab omnibus iis optima Responsa accepe-rim, decreveram, ut promissionis fidem exsolverem, ad Celsitudinem V. recte contendere: partim ut pro singulari ipsius humanitate & bene-

page.notes: The first word of the text is a large woodcut-style initial "C" joined to "um" (Cum). Several words are damaged by print wear, notably "perfunctus", "Celsitudinem", "recte", "singulari" and "ipsius", which are read with doubt. The line "N 4" is a gathering signature at the foot, not text. Words at the line ends are uncertain where the ink is broken.
